summary: Agent skill that makes coding agents keep their plan, findings and progress in Markdown files so they can pick up after /clear or a crash.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: planning-with-files is a skill for Claude Code and 60+ other agents that makes the agent store its working state on disk in three files: task_plan.md (phases and checkboxes), findings.md (research notes and decisions) and progress.md (session log and test results). With the Claude Code plugin, hooks re-inject the active plan each turn, so the agent stays on track even after /clear.
sixtySeconds.problem: Long agent tasks fall apart when the context is cleared or the session crashes. Keeping the plan in files gives the agent a resume point.
whoFor: Claude Code users on long tasks
Users of other agents that support Agent Skills
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a simple 3-file pattern, slash commands for planning and status, and hooks that keep the plan in front of the agent.
requirements: A coding agent (Claude Code for the full plugin)

overview: Install globally with the skills CLI for any agent, or use the Claude Code plugin route, which adds hooks and slash commands.
Run /plan to create the three files and start; /status shows the current phase; /plan-doctor checks the setup.
The planning files are working memory and are gitignored by default. It is MIT licensed.
